howto.text:
Before printing: click any [PLACEHOLDER] and type the number of trial families. Paste a QR code image into the dashed box if you have one.

New language: duplicate one poster and retype the text.

The privacy lines are a plain-language summary for a trial, not legal advice: have them reviewed before a public launch.
